rows.grounds: locative of compound sandhyā-upāsana-viccheda indicating circumstance
numerical expression indicating the count to be recited
prescriptive optative expressing the remedial action
indeclinable indicating application in the stated case

items.question: What recitation remedies the fault arising from an interruption of twilight worship?
premises: An interruption of twilight worship creates a fault requiring remedy.
A recitation numbering one thousand is prescribed in that circumstance.
The prescribed recitation is to be performed as the remedial act.
items.inference: Reciting one thousand times serves as the remedy for the interruption of twilight worship.
uncertainties: Whether sahasra+ekaṃ specifies exactly one thousand or one thousand and one is not fully explicit.
items.plain_english: If the twilight worship is interrupted, one should likewise recite one thousand times.
